description: Frontend + Backend code quality hooks - Prettier, ESLint, TypeScript, Vite, ktlint, detekt, Flyway

hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.ts || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.tsx || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.js || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.jsx || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.json || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.css ]]; then cd "$(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH")" && cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/frontend" && npx prettier --write "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" 2>&1 || true; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.ts || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.tsx || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.js || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.jsx ]]; then cd "$(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH")" && cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/frontend" && npx eslint "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" --fix 2>&1 || true; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.ts || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.tsx ]]; then cd "$(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH")" && cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/frontend" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *package.json ]]; then cd "$(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH")" && cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/frontend" && npm audit --audit-level=moderate 2>&1 | head -30 || true; fi
hooks.description: 4. [FE] npm audit - 보안 취약점 체크 (package.json 변경 시)

hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *package.json || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *vite.config.ts || "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *tsconfig*.json ]]; then cd "$(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH")" && cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/frontend" && timeout 15 npx vite build --mode development 2>&1 | tail -20 || echo 'Build check skipped or timed out'; fi
hooks.description: 5. [FE] Vite build check - 설정 파일 변경 시 빌드 검증 (15초 타임아웃)

hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == *.kt ]]; then cd "$(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH")" && cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/backend" && ./gradlew detekt --auto-correct -q 2>&1 | head -30 || true; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH" == */db/migration/*.sql ]]; then cd "$(dirname "$CLAUDE_TOOL_FILE_PATH")" && cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/backend" && ./gradlew flywayValidate -q 2>&1 | head -20 || true; fi
hooks.description: 7. [BE] Flyway 검증 - migration SQL 파일 문법 체크
